about.title: Good software starts with
paragraphs: I’m a backend-focused developer with experience building Java and Spring Boot services, REST endpoints, and MySQL-backed features. I enjoy turning product requirements into clear APIs and dependable application logic.
I’ve also worked across frontend integration, PHP, and JavaScript. I’m now focusing on growing as a Java backend developer and am open to relevant opportunities.
